FRONTSP.reason: Clear, checkable growth story, but 26x trailing P/E already prices much of it. Next check: verify CFO/PAT and the Railways order book against the Rs 500 Cr FY27 guidance.

GULPOLY.reason: Very low P/E (6x) with a thesis testable on one variable, OMC allocation and procurement price. Next check: FY27 allocation volumes and why FY25 CFO was weak versus FY26.

SRM.reason: Cheap (7.7x) with a quantified order book and FY27 guidance to track. Next check: receivable days and CFO/PAT trend in H1 FY27 results, plus tunnel contract risk.

JSLL.reason: Strong numbers at a moderate P/E, but a 44% healthcare margin is the whole question. Next check: revenue mix (cash versus panel) and receivables from the annual report.

544406.reason: Profit growth lagging sales and an unrelated safety-equipment pivot weaken the thesis. Next check: H1 FY27 margins and capital allocated to the new venture.

CRIZAC.reason: Cheap with good cash conversion, but 97% UK exposure and Q1 FY27 revenue -4% are the test. Next check: Q2 FY27 revenue trend and UK student-visa policy changes.

KRISHNADEF.reason: Rich valuation (35x trailing, 47x on FY26 PAT) against a thin Rs 103 Cr order book. Next check: whether the Rs 221 Cr tender pipeline converts into orders in the next two quarters.

544150.reason: Low P/E, large order book and an easily sized risk. Next check: related-party revenue share and receivables from KP Group in the annual report, plus what drives D/E of 1.35.

TAC.reason: Tiny, lumpy base, with H2 profit down 31% suggesting deal-driven H1. Next check: recurring versus one-off revenue split and H1 FY27 results.

DYCL.reason: Fair valuation and an understandable cable business, but margin pressure and withdrawn ratings are open flags. Next check: reason for rating withdrawal and Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin.

GANDHITUBE.reason: Quality niche with buyback and dividends, but slow growth and material other income cap upside. Next check: operating profit excluding other income and the Q4 FY26 decline cause.

ARROWGREEN.reason: Rebound claim is easy to verify yet currently unverified, after FY26 revenue fell 18%. Next check: confirm Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 90 Cr and profit Rs 27 Cr against the exchange filing.

APCOTEXIND.reason: Profit recovery came from margins with flat sales, and P/E on FY26 PAT is already 25x. Next check: capacity utilisation after the expansion and Chinese import pricing.

MODISONLTD.reason: Profit rides on silver inventory and hedge gains, so earnings quality is hard to read. Next check: normalised margin excluding silver gains and exposure if silver reverses.

SOTL.reason: Normalised 24.5x P/E leaves little cushion; headline cheapness is a windfall artefact. Next check: Savita GreenTec merger swap ratio and related-party terms.

overall: Practical priorities: SRM, GULPOLY, FRONTSP and KP Green have the clearest, cheapest-to-test theses, each hinging on one document (receivables, OMC allocations, order book, related-party disclosure). JSLL and Crizac merit work because a single check (margin source, UK trend) decides them. Lower-ranked names carry valuation that already reflects the story (Krishna Defence, Apcotex, Savita) or earnings that are lumpy or windfall-driven (TAC, Modison, Arrow). Missing CFO data across many names is the most common first gap to close.
